data.one_liner: Cache Dio HTTP responses using sqflite disk and LRU memory
data.what_it_does: Stores HTTP responses locally and serves them based on maxAge and maxStale settings. It integrates as a Dio interceptor and can distinguish cache hits via a response header.
use_when: Need offline support for Dio requests
Want to reduce network traffic for repeat requests
Require fine‑grained cache control per request
avoid_when: Need a global cache across multiple clients
Complex cache invalidation logic beyond maxAge/maxStale
strengths: Easy to add as a Dio interceptor
Configurable disk and memory cache limits
Supports custom primary/sub keys and encryption
Automatic stale handling and cache clearing
weaknesses: Depends on sqflite, adding a native dependency
Only works with Dio, not http or other clients
No built‑in support for cache purging policies beyond maxAge/maxStale
data.setup_notes: Add dio_http_cache to pubspec, create DioCacheManager with CacheConfig, add its interceptor to Dio, optionally set buildCacheOptions on requests.
